_comment: Recorded on main 64d1e7126 (before memory slice 6) by running a real hub chat turn: one note, swept, no facts, no pages. The admitted payload without tools, per scope, and main renderer output for the default chat palette.

function.description: List desk primitives by kind. Find a note with kind=notes. Read each result by its id with desk.get. The desk schema advertises 18 primitive kinds; this tool operates on the 6 authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, and chains.
function.name: desk.list

function.description: Get one desk primitive by kind and ID. Read a note with kind=notes and the id from desk.list. Read a zone and its filed objects with kind=directories. The desk schema advertises 18 primitive kinds; this tool operates on the 6 authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, and chains.
function.name: desk.get

id.description: Object ID from desk.list for the same kind.

function.description: Create a desk primitive. Write a note with kind=notes and data containing a title, body_markdown and tags. Make a zone with kind=directories, a name and optional parent_id. Put a decision on my review list with kind=decisions and status=proposed. Write the reason for a decision with kind=decisions in data.context_markdown. Authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, chains.
function.name: desk.create

data.description: Fields: notes note_id,title,body_markdown,tags; directories (zones) directory_id,name,parent_id from desk.list; kbs kb_id,name,member_ids kind:id; decisions title,status=proposed,context_markdown(reason/facts),decision_markdown(what),consequences_markdown(result),deciders,alternatives,tags. Kind IDs generate if absent; data.id refused.

function.description: Update a desk primitive. Rename a zone with kind=directories and name. Move a zone with kind=directories and parent_id. Set parent_id to null to move it to the desk root. Edit a note with kind=notes and title, body_markdown or tags. Change a decision with kind=decisions. Supply context_markdown, decision_markdown or consequences_markdown to replace the old text. Authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, chains.
function.name: desk.update

data.description: Fields to change, as for desk.create.

id.description: Object ID from desk.list for the same kind.

function.description: List or search active meetings; set parked to list retained parked meetings.
function.name: meeting.list

function.description: Get one stored meeting.
function.name: meeting.get

function.description: File a primitive in a Zone. File a note into a zone by setting directory_id from desk.list kind=directories and primitive_id to note:<id>. Filing a primitive again moves it.
function.name: zone.file

primitive_id.description: Object kind:id; for example note:<id> with its ID from desk.list kind=notes.

function.description: Remove a primitive from a Zone: directory_id and kind:id primitive_id.
function.name: zone.unfile

primitive_id.description: Filed object kind:id; ID from desk.list (for example note:<id> with its ID from desk.list kind=notes).

function.description: List Zone members. List the notes in a zone. Each member has a primitive_id such as note:<id>.
function.name: zone.list_members

function.description: Read one coherent snapshot of the durable HoldSpeak desk.
function.name: desk.snapshot

function.description: List decision records, newest first.
function.name: decision_record.list

function.description: Get a decision record with sources, work, revisions.
function.name: decision_record.get

function.description: Search decision records and affected work.
function.name: decision_record.search

function.description: Read Follow-Through cards; filter project/owner/lane.
function.name: follow_through.board

function.description: Apply a completion verb to a Follow-Through card.
function.name: follow_through.complete

function.description: Create an accountable commitment from an accepted decision.
function.name: follow_through.commit_decision

function.description: Read the latest persisted Monday Brief; generate=true when none exists.
function.name: monday_brief.get

function.description: Search memory: decisions, meetings (transcript, summary), notes, threads, actions, project milestones/risks, sends, published updates, prep briefs, calendar events. Returns records; use project.list for projects; read permission applies.
function.name: memory.search

kind.description: Kinds: decision, decision_record, desk_decision, artifact, meeting, note, thread, action, project_item, workbench_item, cadence, send, project_update, prep_brief, calendar_event.

function.description: Read the content-free People MCP capability and encrypted-store readiness. This never initializes the store or returns relationship data.
function.name: people.readiness

function.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict. Only shared-intent crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. List active relationship metadata from the encrypted People store.
function.name: people.relationship.list

function.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict. Only shared-intent crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Get one relationship with only shared-intent 1:1s, agenda items, requests, and commitments.
function.name: people.relationship.get

function.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict. Only shared-intent crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Add one shared-intent agenda item to a notes-only 1:1.
function.name: people.agenda.add

rolled_from_id.description: Optional open agenda item to roll forward atomically.

function.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict. Only shared-intent crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Create a durable shared-intent grounding note. Encrypted at rest; not indexed or submitted to a model.
function.name: people.note.create

function.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict. Only shared-intent crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Compute a read-time 1:1 brief: open shared-intent commitments/agenda, grounding note count, last linked meetings with open action items, decision records, and unlinked meeting count in the window. Never persists any data.
function.name: people.one_on_one.brief

function.description: Read the Dashboard Door aggregate projection.
function.name: door.get

function.description: Add a Door action item; creates a Follow-Through card with optional owner and due date.
function.name: door.add_item

source_type.description: Source kind; chat defaults to thread.

function.description: Set the persistent thread status line; it persists across turns.
function.name: thread.set_status

function.description: Where can I send? This lists saved destinations: folders, GitHub issues or pull requests, Jira work items, Confluence spaces and email. Each result has a name, channel, account, target, badge (local or cloud), state and connection state.
function.name: channel.destinations

function.description: Prepare a send of a stored document using "send the update to <destination>" or "send this artifact to <destination>". The prepared send freezes its destination and exact preview bytes. Nothing leaves the machine. Only the owner can send or discard it.
function.name: channel.prepare

command_id.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key with the same arguments returns the first result again; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_conflict.
